items.title: The post-penny economy: How cash rounding and credit card surcharges are changing what you pay
items.title_zh: 后「分币」经济：现金取整与信用卡附加费如何改变你的支付
items.summary: More merchants are rounding change for cash purchases to the nearest nickel due to the end of penny production, or adding surcharges to credit card transactions
items.summary_zh: 由于一分硬币停止铸造，越来越多商家将现金消费找零取整到最近五分，或是对信用卡交易加收附加费。

items.title: Meta settles social media addiction case with California, other states for $16.7 billion
items.title_zh: Meta 与加州等州就社交媒体成瘾案达成 167 亿美元和解
items.summary: Meta and state attorneys general settled a federal trial centering on allegations that company misrepresented the extent of child-related mental health harms.
items.summary_zh: Meta 与多州总检察长就一桩联邦审判达成和解，该案件核心指控公司歪曲了儿童心理健康损害的严重程度。
